narration: The oldest, darkest cold traps hold the most ice. In the most ancient ones, more than ten percent of the surface is covered.
visual_brief: Radar ice map of the lunar pole.

candidates.title: Thickness of Mars South Polar Layered Deposits
candidates.description: This map shows the thickness of the south polar layered deposits of Mars, an ice-rich geologic unit that was probed by the Mars Advanced Radar for Subsurface and Ionospheric Sounding MARSIS

candidates.title: Peeling Back Layers of a Martian Polar Ice Cap Artist Concept
candidates.description: This artist animation illustrates how NASA Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter used radar to map the insides of the north polar ice cap on Mars.

candidates.title: Radar Mapping of Icy Layers Under Mars North Pole
candidates.description: This composite graphic illustrates the use of the Shallow Radar instrument on NASA Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter for mapping underground ice-rich layers of the north polar layered terrain on Mars.

candidates.title: Location of Large Subsurface Water-Ice Deposit in Utopia Planitia, Mars
candidates.description: Diagonal striping on this map of a portion of the Utopia Planitia region on Mars indicates the area where a large subsurface deposit rich in water ice was assessed using the Shallow Radar (SHARAD) instrument on NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter.
